dedupe_keys.name: real meshed district heating network dataset verbier switzerland with citysim inputs and measurements

description: This data set describes a real meshed district heating network in Verbier, Switzerland, so that simulation tools can be validated and compared on a common baseline. It was published on Zenodo in August 2026 (updated September 2026) by Dubon Rodrigue and Jérôme Kämpf, with a conference paper. The network has 159 consumers, 3 producers, 532 junctions and 699 supply and return pipe pairs. Complete anonymised CitySim inputs using a three-node heat transport model at 60 s and 5 s thermal steps hold connectivity, pipe properties, model parameters and time-varying boundary conditions, together with a climate file, seven files of anonymised field measurements and CitySim reference results. A README documents anonymisation, units, boundary conditions and how to align results. Coverage is one network in Verbier. Files are XML, CSV and text outputs in a zipped archive of about 49 MB, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: node coordinates are a synthetic schematic, not the real layout, and names are pseudonymised. Simulation uses are validating thermal-hydraulic district heating models and benchmarking simulation tools and digital twins. Related records: data-opendhn-verbier-meshed-district-heating-benchmark gives averaged measurements from the same network.
